Identity lines are my one-line summaries of each ascendancy notable set (names and stat lines from the wiki). They are not wiki prose; verify before design use.
Some notable names in the wiki data are placeholders (for example Occultist <<HRB34>> style names, Deadeye flavour names). Identity lines lean on the stat lines where available.

ascendancies.name: Ascendant
ascendancies.identity: Path nodes that let the build allocate passives from another class starting point (Ranger, Witch, Marauder, Duelist, Templar, Shadow).

ascendancies.name: Luminary
ascendancies.identity: Mercenary-linked support: buffs a linked Mercenary (taunt, auras, unique equipment, cheaper Link skills).

ascendancies.name: Reliquarian
ascendancies.identity: Display nodes that reward showing specific unique items (martial weapon, caster weapon, armour, jewellery). Stat lines not captured.

ascendancies.name: Berserker
ascendancies.identity: Rage-based melee: rage gain and loss rules, Strike-skill and leech notables (Crave the Slaughter, Aspect of Carnage).

ascendancies.name: Chieftain
ascendancies.identity: Slam and strike melee with triggered effects and elemental-resistance sharing (Tasalio, Valako, Tukohama).

ascendancies.name: Juggernaut
ascendancies.identity: Tank: endurance charges, life and armour defence, action-speed floors (Ancestral Endurance, Toughened Skin).

ascendancies.name: Deadeye
ascendancies.identity: Projectile attacks: attack projectiles can fork extra times, mana-based damage notables.

ascendancies.name: Pathfinder
ascendancies.identity: Flask, shrine and nature utility (Master Distiller, Master Toxicist, Woodland Shrines, Innate Blessing).

ascendancies.name: Raider
ascendancies.identity: Spectral wolf summons, shared charges and minion scaling (Pack Mentality, Greatwolf's Call).
ascendancies.note: Wiki page title is Warden; display name in data is Raider.

ascendancies.name: Elementalist
ascendancies.identity: Elemental spells: Elemental Conflux on kills and herald area (Retribution, Tribulation).

ascendancies.name: Necromancer
ascendancies.identity: Minion, poison, chaos and curse focus (Venom Drinker, Rotten Core, Vile Imprecations).

ascendancies.name: Occultist
ascendancies.identity: Hex and cooldown focus with Visiting Harbinger summons. Some notable names are placeholders in the wiki data.

ascendancies.name: Champion
ascendancies.identity: Defensive melee with aura and fortification support (Fortitude, Inspirational, Worthy Foe).

ascendancies.name: Gladiator
ascendancies.identity: Lucky and Unlucky risk rules, block and ailment or stun avoidance (Spectacular Parlay, Risk Aversion).

ascendancies.name: Slayer
ascendancies.identity: Attribute stacking and gem quality (Centerpiece, Private Tuition, Fancy Foil, Illicit Gains).

ascendancies.name: Assassin
ascendancies.identity: Critical-strike and poison focus with elusive and life-recoup notables (Toxic Delivery, Mistwalker).

ascendancies.name: Saboteur
ascendancies.identity: Chill, freeze and shock with reactive ailments (Brine Bound, Within the Tempest, Changing Seasons).

ascendancies.name: Trickster
ascendancies.identity: Shade Form on being hit, curse-limit scaling with Power Charges, blinding (Formless, Faithless, Sightless).

ascendancies.name: Guardian
ascendancies.identity: Pantheon-style Devout of <god> nodes: each grants a god blessing (hex reflection, ground immunity, charges).

ascendancies.name: Hierophant
ascendancies.identity: Minion and hex focus: half Strength to minions, Marionettes, Feeding Frenzy, Hexbearer.

ascendancies.name: Inquisitor
ascendancies.identity: Vaal skills and chaos or corruption (Chaos Reigns, Fever for Corruption, Depose Order).
